author: John Hammond
description:
Windows notifications are something most people trust without a second thought.

This walkthrough explores how legitimate Windows features can be used to create convincing notifications, and why understanding these techniques matters for defenders as much as attackers.

Watch the full video here: https://youtu.be/wrAFZLa1TAk?si=CxyHDhZ_iMSh3Ia1
title: Building Fake Notifications
